propagate_einsum_sharding: propagate sharding of inputs to output for ops following einsum notation like matrix multiplication
propagate_pointwise_sharding: propagate sharding for pointwise operations like addition or multiplication with broadcasting support
propagate_inplace_sharding: propagate sharding for inplace operations that write to an output tensor while preserving input placement
propagate_out_variant_sharding: propagate sharding for out-variant operations that accept an explicit output argument
generate_reshard_suggestions: generate reshard suggestions when input placements require resharding for op sharding propagation
